name: Built-in bathtub
description: White acrylic built-in bath (standard 170 x 70, rim at 55, ~42 cm deep inside) with tiled front and end panels, a bar mixer with spout and a hand shower on the back wall at the mixer end, optional fixed glass screen (140 high) on the front edge at that end.

panelMaterial.description: texture id of the front/end panels

mixerSide.description: left | right: end with the mixer, hand shower, drain and screen
